pg.dd.drop: Drop files here, or click to browse
pg.dd.roadmap.label: ROADMAP
pg.dd.sourceLine.0: Sync your pages, or use them live.
pg.dd.sourceLine.3: Connect to sync or import files.
pg.dev.early.lines.0: Can use your Mac: see, click, type. Needs Homebrew and macOS permissions
pg.dev.early.lines.1: Can drive Chrome through a connector
pg.dev.early.lines.2: Local agent API and SDK. No public cloud API
pg.dev.label: For developers
pg.dev.today.lines.4: Works beside your editor (it is not an IDE)
pg.feature.browser.also: A built-in browser for you and for agentic browsing
pg.feature.browser.name: Browser
pg.feature.browser.note: With extra setup it can use your Mac (see, click, type) and drive Chrome through a connector.
pg.feature.browser.today: It previews the pages and files it builds, right inside the app.
pg.feature.coding.name: Coding
pg.feature.coding.today: It writes and edits real files, runs real commands and shows you every change. It works beside your editor.
pg.feature.connections.also: A public cloud API for the cognitive layer and orchestration
pg.feature.connections.name: API and connections
pg.feature.connections.note: A local agent API and SDK are early and need setup.
pg.feature.connections.today: 50+ connectors you switch on one by one, several agents working in parallel, and research on demand with sources you can open.
pg.feature.flow.also: Mind-map view of the whole process
pg.feature.flow.name: Process flow
pg.feature.flow.note: Flow charts and diagrams are drawn in the app once you switch them on.
pg.feature.flow.today: A live roadmap shows every stage of the work and which one is running now.
pg.feature.knowledge.also: A structured, encrypted knowledge base of every project, with a short record of your details: name, email, phones, accounts
pg.feature.knowledge.name: Knowledge base
pg.feature.knowledge.note: It can remember how you like things done once you switch memory on.
pg.feature.knowledge.today: Every chat is saved on your Mac and searchable, by you and by the AI.
pg.feature.local.name: Local inference
pg.feature.local.note: Each model is a one-time download in setup before its first use.
pg.feature.local.today: Run open-source models right on your Mac. Search Hugging Face from the app, download a model and chat with it locally.
pg.feature.lockdown.also: Instant app lock with a PIN or a security key (U2F, YubiKey)
pg.feature.lockdown.name: Control and lockdown
pg.feature.lockdown.today: You set the rules: approve every action, only the risky ones, or let it run. You can stop any run at any moment.
pg.feature.projects.also: Open a project and carry on where you left off, with its files, plan and decisions already in context
pg.feature.projects.name: Work projects
pg.feature.projects.today: A project keeps everything for one piece of work in one place: its chats, knowledge base files, workflows, tasks and results.
pg.feature.prompts.name: Editable system prompts
pg.feature.prompts.today: Read and rewrite the instructions the AI follows, in plain words, in Settings. Reset any of them to the default at any time.
pg.feature.providers.name: Configurable model providers
pg.feature.providers.today: Choose the AI behind the work: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, Ollama and more, or add your own provider. Your API keys are encrypted and kept on your Mac.
pg.feature.sandbox.name: Sandbox for apps
pg.feature.sandbox.today: Ask for a small app and it builds one. Each app runs in its own sandboxed window with strict security rules.
pg.feature.schedule.name: Scaling
pg.feature.schedule.today: Save any job as a recipe, run it again, or let it run on a schedule.
pg.feature.scheduler.name: Scheduler
pg.feature.scheduler.today: Pick when a job runs: every morning, every Monday or on your own timetable. It starts on time without you.
pg.feature.skills.name: Skills library
pg.feature.skills.today: Skills teach the AI how to do a job your way. Browse them in one place, add your own, and it uses the right one when the job needs it.
pg.feature.tracker.also: One board for all your agents, in groups and categories, across projects
pg.feature.tracker.name: Task tracker
pg.feature.tracker.today: Every move the AI makes, as it happens: grouped by step, with the file, command or error behind each one, and a live timer.
pg.feature.vault.also: A password vault that keeps your own logins encrypted in the app
pg.feature.vault.name: Passwords
pg.feature.vault.today: Your Orqanix sign-in is stored in the macOS Keychain, never in a file.
pg.feature.voice.also: Spoken replies, so you can talk with it voice to voice
pg.feature.voice.name: Voice control
pg.feature.voice.today: Talk instead of typing. Say "submit" and the message is sent.
pg.feature.workspace.name: Workspace panel
pg.feature.workspace.today: A side panel that reshapes itself around each request: live status, the plan, every file and the final result. It tells you when it needs you. Review there, discuss in chat.
pg.features.legend: Some parts are off until you switch them on.
pg.features.title: In the app today

pg.how.more.preview: It previews the pages and files it builds, inside the app.

pg.strip.measure: Measured once each on 18 Sep 2026 in the Orqanix cloud preview, not in the desktop app, one test scenario. Exact: 1.86 s · 19.08 s (767 words) · 84.04 s (3,951 words). Not averages; yours will differ. A full starter pack is many pieces and takes longer.
